issue.message: Not targeting the latest versions of Android; compatibility modes apply. Consider testing and updating this version. Consult the `android.os.Build.VERSION_CODES` javadoc for details.

The attribute `android:allowBackup` is deprecated from Android 12 and may be removed in future versions. Consider adding the attribute `android:dataExtractionRules` specifying an `@xml` resource which configures backups and device transfers on Android 12 and higher.
This folder configuration (`v26`) is unnecessary; `minSdkVersion` is 33. Merge all the resources in this folder into `mipmap-anydpi`.

`onTouch` lambda should call `View#performClick` when a click is detected
